title: Honey Cake
description: A dense, moist one-layer cake using ground flaked almonds instead of flour, with whisked egg whites for height and a drizzle of honey on top.
steps: Preheat the oven to 190°C/170°C fan. Grease and line a 20cm round cake tin.
Separate the eggs and whisk the whites to stiff peaks. Beat the yolks with 4 tablespoons of the honey.
Blitz 125g of the flaked almonds in a food processor to grind them. Toast the remaining 25g in the oven for 5–10 minutes.
Mix the ground almonds with the egg yolks and honey, then gradually fold in the egg whites with a metal spoon.
Transfer to the cake tin and bake for 25 minutes, lowering the temperature to 180°C/160°C fan for the final 10 minutes.
Allow to cool completely before turning out. Drizzle the final tablespoon of honey over the top and scatter with toasted almonds.
notes: Serves 8–10. Keeps 1–2 days in an airtight tin.
